fb5c2d93-1b70-58e3-96d2-a0a790b75439.content: Upload a single PDF file to the submission portal.

3f4b26bc-0c12-5733-a606-8d3bc618ac23.content: Ensure that text in the submitted PDF is searchable.

d82111a2-69c7-57db-894c-2f3259978c5c.content: Keep the uploaded file size at or below 10 MB.

508637d2-cf62-5a3e-97c9-cc4ff0eee6f5.content: Submit before 5:00 PM Eastern Time on the deadline indicated in the announcement.

52541b04-e647-5719-9b0e-1fa15c441938.content: The administrator considers the portal server timestamp, rather than when the author initiated the upload, as authoritative evidence of submission completion.

5725d78e-1d60-55c3-ac64-9664f3468c42.content: Submission portal forms and announcement requirements may vary by submission cycle.
